sections.description: All: set the priors of every number of states from Min to Max. Current: only the selected one.

sections.label: Min Center
sections.description: Mean signal of the lowest state; the states' centers are spread evenly from Min to Max Center.

sections.label: Max Center
sections.description: Mean signal of the highest state.

sections.label: Noise
sections.description: Expected standard deviation of the signal around a state's center.

sections.label: Dwell
sections.description: Expected number of frames spent in a state before a transition.

sections.label: Center
sections.description: How many observations the center prior is worth. Low values let superfluous states stay empty.

sections.label: Noise
sections.description: How many observations the noise prior is worth.

sections.label: Dwell
sections.description: How many observations the dwell-time prior is worth.
